_comment: Template for .mcp.json — project-scope MCP server configuration.
Remove this _comment key before writing to production.
Secrets MUST use ${ENV_VAR} interpolation — never hardcode tokens.
Limit alwaysLoad:true to 1-2 servers. Others are deferred until needed.
Place this file at the project root, NOT inside .claude/

example-cloud-api._comment: Remote HTTP server using OAuth authentication (recommended for cloud APIs).

example-local-tools._comment: Local stdio server. Uses env vars for secrets. alwaysLoad:true only if needed every session.
